Savings you put down at the start, with the loan covering the rest
Awkward floppy oblong that bends in the middle as two people carry it
Of Ankara and Istanbul; also of the sweet the Witch conjures from snow
Royal seat; Cair Paravel keeps four of them facing the eastern sea
Sweeper that names the cupboard under the stairs, and does the floorboards
Long fur garment brushed past on the way into a snowy wood
Lawyer handling the searches, the enquiries and the money on the day
Fine mesh pegged down over the cabbages to keep the butterflies off
